# Braids adapter — cursor

| | |
|---|---|
| Status | `experimental` |
| Adapter version | 0.1.0-dev.2 |
| Methodology version | 3.1.0 |
| Surfaces | desktop, cli, cloud |
| Host versions exercised | none |
| Primary sources revalidated | 2026-08-31 |
| Guard Mode default | off |

This adapter contains no Braids methodology. It packages the canonical
`skills/braids` kernel unchanged; `python3 scripts/build_adapters.py --dist dist`
writes the installable tree.

## Generated manifests

- `plugin.json`
- `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`

## Install

1. python3 scripts/build_adapters.py --dist dist --only cursor
2. local testing: cp -r dist/cursor ~/.cursor/plugins/local/braids
3. direct skill, project scope: cp -r skills/braids <project>/.cursor/skills/braids or <project>/.agents/skills/braids
4. reload Cursor so the plugin directory is rescanned

## Disable

1. remove the plugin from ~/.cursor/plugins/local and reload
2. or remove the direct skill directory and reload

## Uninstall

1. rm -rf ~/.cursor/plugins/local/braids
2. rm -rf <project>/.cursor/skills/braids <project>/.agents/skills/braids dist/cursor
3. reload Cursor and confirm braids no longer appears in the plugin list

| discovery | not-exercised | the host is not installed in this environment, so packaging is validated statically only |

| progressive-disclosure | pass | the package ships seven independently routed skills, keeps core references one level deep, and adds no persistent instruction file, matching the host's documented discovery/activation/execution loading |
| authority | pass | adapter ships no rules, hooks, agents, commands, variables or MCP, so it cannot widen the host permission model |
| degradation | pass | no MCP, LSP or hook dependency is declared, so absent optional tools remove no adapter behaviour |
| enforcement-truthfulness | not-applicable | this adapter claims no deterministic blocking |
| state-survival | not-exercised | compaction and resume behaviour was not measured |
| isolation | not-applicable | no subagents or worktrees are shipped |
| uninstall | not-exercised | the host is not installed in this environment, so packaging is validated statically only |

`not-exercised` means exactly that: the behaviour was not directly tested here
and is not claimed.

## Limitations

- Cursor documents no plugin disable or uninstall contract; local removal is folder deletion plus reload, and marketplace lifecycle is unverified.
- User-level skill directories are not copied to Cloud Agents, remote SSH agents or managed workers, so cloud execution needs its own capability profile.
- Cloud supports command hooks only, omits several local lifecycle events, excludes user hooks, and runs no hooks during initial read-only exploration.
- Third-party Claude hook compatibility runs all matching sources by precedence, so a Braids registration could execute twice if that mode is ever enabled.
- Two manifests are generated because Cursor reads both the portable Agent Plugin root plugin.json and the enhanced .cursor-plugin/plugin.json; neither carries Braids methodology.
- Cursor is the only supported host with a documented manifest logo field, so it is the only package that carries a brand asset; the 256 px icon is 59 KB. Claude Code 2.1.248 rejects both icon and logo as unknown fields under --strict.
